name: Buscar Facturas en Correo — Multi-tenant + multi-provider

nodes.name: Webhook — Recibir Búsqueda
nodes.notes:
Recibe del backend SaaS:
  - requestId, apiKey, empresaId
  - startDate, endDate (rango fechas)
  - email (filtro remitente, opcional)
  - email_provider: 'outlook'|'gmail'|'yahoo'|'imap'
  - credential_email_id: ID de la credencial en n8n
  - callbackUrl (opcional override)

additionalFields.filter: hasAttachments eq true and receivedDateTime ge {{$('Extraer Contexto').item.json.startDate}}T00:00:00Z and receivedDateTime le {{$('Extraer Contexto').item.json.endDate}}T23:59:59Z{{$('Extraer Contexto').item.json.email ? " and from/emailAddress/address eq '" + $('Extraer Contexto').item.json.email + "'" : ''}}

filters.q: ={{ 'has:attachment after:' + $('Extraer Contexto').item.json.startDate + ' before:' + $('Extraer Contexto').item.json.endDate + ($('Extraer Contexto').item.json.email ? ' from:' + $('Extraer Contexto').item.json.email : '') }}

nodes.name: Yahoo · IMAP
nodes.notes: Para Yahoo: usa servidor imap.mail.yahoo.com puerto 993 SSL, y app password (no contraseña principal)
